scores.tell: Orange-brown wood background and orange floor sit close in hue to the cap's wood, so the card is warm-heavy. The white and navy cap is a good accent, but real cards separate hero from background more.
Natural green stripes with blue and orange accents match the real fan and window cards. The pale lilac air-con body is a bit washed out, and the background is as loud as the hero.
Salmon-red to orange gradient sky over a peach floor is a warm monotone. The chair is a flat saturated green with orange caps, and the pastel floor is not seen on real cards.
Saturated blue sea with gold, red wood and a pink/blue gem accent is close to the real palette. The sand is slightly pale. Shadow hues stay rich.
Dark crimson curtain and orange-yellow wood are both heavy and warm. The podium is a single yellow-orange mass that blends with the floor, and the red is deeper than in real cards.
Orange concentric background with a dark purple hat and a purple band is a clean complement. It matches the real cards' bold single-hue backgrounds. Almost no tell.
Hot pink wavy background, lime slide and blue pool put four loud hues at equal chroma. There is no neutral to rest the eye, and the pale tile floor is the only rest.
Teal room, pink, blue and a rainbow of balls all run at one loud chroma. There are too many hue families, and the pastel pink body is milky. The real cards are more controlled.
Blue sky, green grass and orange wheels are natural local colors. The cream canopy is a good neutral. The brown dirt and grass fill is slightly dull next to the real cards.
Saturated blue background with a yellow and orange broom and a red band is a clear hero and background split. It is very close to the real towel and whistle cards.
